title: Stochastic Optimal Control Matching
tldr_zh: 把随机最优控制变成最小二乘回归，用 path-wise reparameterization trick 降方差，4 个控制问题中 3 个取得最低 L2 误差。
tldr_en: Casts stochastic optimal control as least-squares regression with a path-wise reparameterization trick for variance reduction; lowest L2 error on 3 of 4 control problems.

key_numbers.number: 10x lower error than all existing IDO methods on Quadratic OU (easy)
5x smaller error than any existing method on Linear OU
SOCM per-iteration time 0.222 s vs Cross-entropy 0.086 s (Quadratic OU easy)
Cross-entropy control objective 2.915 ± 0.008 at d=64 in Gaussian mixture sampling
Double Well terminal cost g has 1024 modes
